description:
Fast, local-first desktop app for notes, journaling, and knowledge work.

Skriuw is a fast, local-first desktop app for notes, journaling, and knowledge work. Version 2 keeps the workspace in local SQLite storage with portable archives and Git-backed history.
Changes since v2-v0.50.0
- chore(v2): release v2-v0.51.0
- fix(toast): anchor the toast stack to the visual viewport (#539)
- feat(editor): link bare domains with a known top-level domain (#538)
- feat(site): heading anchors and a table of contents on shared notes (#536)
- feat(sharing): publish images with shared notes (#537)
- fix(sharing): stop sharing notes moved to the trash (#535)
- fix(site): make links in shared notes and docs visibly links (#534)
- feat(v2): math macros, paste and mhchem, starter guides, and one settings copy module (#533)
- chore(sync): apply D1 migrations as part of the deploy scripts (#532)
- ci: apply D1 migrations on Worker deploys and run the native gate on every PR (#531)
